selection_reason: Hybrid-context kept validation hit@5 at 80% but lost a baseline success and lowered hit@1 from 55% to 50%. Vector-context preserved every validation success and rank, was faster, and fixed both development misses. Prefer the conservative strategy as default; retain hybrid variants as experiments.
validation_reclassification: The first 20 heldout questions were used for strategy selection and are now validation data, not the final untouched test.

settings.adjacency: same normalized record, gap at most 10 characters, next then previous
settings.deduplication: same notice scopes and identical assembled body, at least 80 normalized characters

predeclared_final_validation.primary: actual context hit@5 must not fall below baseline
predeclared_final_validation.secondary: actual context MRR@5 must not fall below baseline
predeclared_final_validation.limitations: Small assistant-authored question sets; no answer generation or abstention evaluation
